search_strategy: Focus on peer-reviewed empirical research, reviews, and policy documents from 2022 onward, when generative AI tools became widely accessible. Prioritize empirical studies (surveys, experiments, qualitative interviews with students/faculty) over opinion pieces. Include both OpenAlex (broader education/policy coverage) and arXiv (for computational perspectives on LLMs and AI in academia). Exclude general AI ethics papers without education context. Sub-RQ 6 on implementation best practices is likely thinnest given the recency of the phenomenon; sub-RQs 1–2 should yield the most literature. Search across disciplines but prioritize graduate-level research contexts.
